sloka: गृहे गृहे रुदन्त्यः च भर्तारम् गृहम् आगतम् ।व्यगर्हयन्तः दुह्ख आर्ता वाग्भिस् तोत्रैः इव द्विपान् ॥२-४८-६॥
transliteration: gṛhe gṛhe rudantyaḥ ca bhartāram gṛham āgatam ।vyagarhayantaḥ duhkha ārtā vāgbhis totraiḥ iva dvipān ॥2-48-6॥

translations.english: In every house, women wept and in anguish heaped abuses on their husbands on their arrival at home with words (sharp) like goads on elephants:
